specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: Produced as a 3-door hatchback in a variety of trim levels, the City was also available together with the Motocompo, a special 50 cc 'foldaway' scooter with 2.5 PS (1.8 kW) designed to fit in the City's small luggage area ("trunk"); called a "trunk bike", Honda invented the compound word "trabai" for this scooter.

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: All variants were powered by the same 1.5-litre i-VTEC petrol engine which delivers 118 PS (87 kW; 116 hp) of power with 146 Nm of maximum torque.

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: The 1.2 L "BE" was the base model and had a single carburetor, as did the 1.3-litre "CE" and "CG" variants.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: Among the conditions of the tax incentive are Euro 5 compliance, CO2 emissions below 100 g/km (5.7 oz/mi), and a fuel consumption not exceeding 23.25 km/L (4.3 L/100 km; 66 mpg‑imp; 55 mpg‑US).

specs.name: top_speed
specs.source_sentence: The original 1.3 L (1,343 cc) D13B produced 95 PS (70 kW) at 6,400 rpm for a claimed top speed of 171 km/h and 0–100 km/h in 11.3 seconds.
